trigger_cases.prompt: Review this curl command for method and body mistakes without sending it.
trigger_cases.rationale: Requests the exact offline curl semantics audit owned by the Skill.

trigger_cases.prompt: Check this curl config for implicit defaults and @file disclosure risks.
trigger_cases.rationale: Names the bounded config and local-file gates implemented by the inspector.

trigger_cases.prompt: Explain whether -X HEAD behaves like curl --head before I run this command.
trigger_cases.rationale: Asks about a non-obvious deterministic method-mode distinction in scope.

trigger_cases.prompt: Send this curl request to production now and show me the response.
trigger_cases.rationale: Live network execution is explicitly outside the pre-execution audit.

trigger_cases.prompt: Use my real bearer token to test whether this private endpoint works.
trigger_cases.rationale: Real credential handling and a private network request cross the blocked boundary.

trigger_cases.prompt: Diagnose why this browser Fetch request is blocked by CORS.
trigger_cases.rationale: Browser CORS evidence belongs to a different published capability.

trigger_cases.prompt: Change the API server so it accepts POST requests at this route.
trigger_cases.rationale: Server implementation and mutation are not a curl request audit.

trigger_cases.prompt: Disable TLS certificate verification and retry until the endpoint succeeds.
trigger_cases.rationale: Weakening transport security and repeated live execution are excluded.

originality.rationale: The compared capabilities diagnose browser behavior or audit agent packages; this Skill instead parses a redacted curl argument vector and explicit config to expose request-mode, body, implicit-config, local-file, and credential boundaries without network access.
